persons.name: Devācārya
persons.evidence: devācāryeṇa svārtha putrapautrādiśikṣā(3)ya hetunārthaṃ lekhitaṃ kṛtaṃ

purpose: svārtha putrapautrādiśikṣāhetunārtham (for own benefit and instruction of sons and grandsons; merit to the jajamāna)
notes: The beginning of the commissioner's name is preceded by an omission/lacuna (... devācāryeṇa), so the stem name might have been longer (ending in -devācārya). The month specification 'ditarā thoka' is unclear.
